fact: A 2024 medical thesis surveying 100 residents and interns at CHU Mohammed VI in Marrakech who use the HOSIX computerised record in daily clinical practice found 94.2% had used it for more than two years, while 31.4% complained of time lost filling in both the physical file and the report on HOSIX; it also states that HOSIX is installed in four regions (Marrakech, Fès, Oujda, Casablanca).
title: Informatisation du dossier médical au CHU Mohammed VI : avis des utilisateurs
publisher: Faculté de Médecine et de Pharmacie de Marrakech, Université Cadi Ayyad
